policies.name: approval_insert
policies.check:
((approver_account_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.account_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator.creator_profile cp
  WHERE ((cp.id = commerce_approval.creator_id) AND (cp.account_id = commerce_approval.approver_account_id) AND (cp.verification = 'verified'::text) AND (NOT cp.recovery_required)))))

policies.name: approval_read
policies.using:
((approver_account_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.account_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator.team_membership tm
  WHERE ((tm.creator_id = commerce_approval.creator_id) AND (tm.account_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.account_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) AND (tm.revoked_at IS NULL) AND ('drafter'::text = ANY (tm.roles))))))

policies.name: fan_effect_insert
policies.check:
((account_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.account_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) AND (((subject_kind = 'thanks'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (creator.content_thanks t
     JOIN creator.fan_profile f ON ((f.id = t.fan_id)))
  WHERE ((t.id = content_fan_effect.subject_id) AND (t.creator_id = content_fan_effect.creator_id) AND (f.account_id = content_fan_effect.account_id))))) OR ((subject_kind = 'reply'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (creator.content_reply r
     JOIN creator.fan_profile f ON ((f.id = r.fan_id)))
  WHERE ((r.id = content_fan_effect.subject_id) AND (r.creator_id = content_fan_effect.creator_id) AND (f.account_id = content_fan_effect.account_id)))))))

policies.name: reply_read
policies.using:
(creator.commerce_scope(NULL::uuid, fan_id) OR (creator.content_role(creator_id, ARRAY['triage'::text]) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator.content_reply_review r
  WHERE ((r.reply_id = content_reply.id) AND (r.state = 'allowed'::text))))))

policies.name: read_actor
policies.check:
((account_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.account_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) AND creator.content_role(creator_id, ARRAY['triage'::text]) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator.content_reply_review r
  WHERE ((r.reply_id = content_reply_read.reply_id) AND (r.creator_id = content_reply_read.creator_id) AND (r.state <> 'pending'::text) AND (r.withdrawn_at IS NULL)))))

policies.name: thanks_read
policies.using: (creator.commerce_scope(NULL::uuid, fan_id) OR (creator.content_role(creator_id, ARRAY[]::text[]) AND share_digest AND (withdrawn_at IS NULL)))

policies.name: scope_read
policies.using:
((creator_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.creator_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) AND ((account_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.account_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator.creator_media_asset a
  WHERE ((a.id = creator_media_publication.asset_id) AND (a.creator_id = creator_media_publication.creator_id) AND (a.object_id = creator_media_publication.object_id) AND (a.purpose = ANY (ARRAY['human_note'::text, 'post_photo'::text, 'post_audio'::text])) AND (a.state = 'ready'::text) AND ((a.provenance -> 'c2paVerified'::text) = 'true'::jsonb))))))
